lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Who put the stuff in the burn barrel?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How do you know he did?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he tell you he put in the burn barrel?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You just said that he told you he put it in the burn barrel. What did he tell you he put in there?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What kind of things did he put in the burn barrel? What kind of items?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How much money did you guys take from her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He only gave me like a few bucks.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you where he got it?
